_: India is less than 3% Christian, but Christmas remains a national holiday and is often celebrated with star-shaped lanterns or clay lamps placed on rooftops to signify that Jesus is "the light of the world"

Many regions have their own unique holiday customs. For example, Christmas trees in Bali are often made from chicken feathers
